buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 50% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 50 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 50 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 50 percent with the consent of the service provider

2. Provisions for workmen compensation, insurance, public liability, property damage, insurance etc. to be ensured by the contractor. Also, safety measures prescribed for working in Extra High Voltage & use of personnel protective equipment must be adhered to. 3. Generic Bidder financial standing: The bidder should not be under liquidation, court receivership or similar proceedings, should not be bankrupt. Bidder to upload undertaking to this effect with bid. 4. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 5. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 6. Payment PAYMENT OF SALARIES AND WAGES: Service Provider is required to pay Salaries / wages of contracted staff deployed at buyer location first i.e. on their own and then claim payment from Buyer alongwith all statutory documents like, PF, ESIC etc. as well as the bank statement of payment done to staff. 7. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Account Payee Demand Draft in favour of DDO, HQ DFS payable at DELHI . Bidder has to upload scanned copy / proof of the DD along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date / Bid Opening date. 8. Forms of EMD and PBG Bidders can also submit the EMD with Fixed Deposit Receipt made out or pledged in the name of A/C DDO, HQ, DFS . The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of EMD, the FDR will be released in the favour of the bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Bidder has to upload scanned copy/ proof of the FDR along with bid and has to ensure delivery of hardcopy to the Buyer within 5 days of Bid End date/ Bid Opening date 9. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Account Payee Demand Draft also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). DD should be made in favour of DDO, HQ, DFS payable at DELHI . After award of contract, Successful Bidder can upload scanned copy of the DD in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy to the original DD to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 10. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Fixed Deposit Receipt also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). FDR should be made out or pledged in the name of DDO, HQ DFS

A/C (Name of the Seller). The bank should certify on it that the deposit can be withdrawn only on the demand or with the sanction of the pledgee. For release of Security Deposit, the FDR will be released in favour of bidder by the Buyer after making endorsement on the back of the FDR duly signed and stamped along with covering letter. Successful Bidder has to upload scanned copy of the FDR document in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy of Original FDR to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 11. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses The bidders are required to submit an Index of all the documents uploaded along with the bid. All the follo wing documents shall be compiled and submitted in a single PDF file:- a. MSME for exemption for turnover/EMD. b. Past Experience for similar service (As sought at point no. 4 & 12 below) c. A list of 30% (i.e 123 numbers) of manpower of same qualifications (As sought at point no. 11 b elow) d. Escalation Matrix e. Latest Undertaking (After bid floating date) for bankruptcy/liquidation. f. Latest Undertaking (After bid floating date) on Rs.100 Affidavit for Non-Blacklisting of last 5 years. g. Undertaking for minimum wages h. Registered office Delhi, if any i. GSTR 3B of latest month / quarter 2. The successful bidder will be responsible for providing protective gears i.e Dress, Dangree, Gum Boot, H elmet etc. to the Fire Operator. 3. The successful bidder will be responsible for any medical expense in case of Injury/Death duri ng duty/firefighting operations, including compensation liabilities, retrenchment benefits, legal liabiliti es and other statutory obligations. 4. Firms/Companies should have minimum 1 year experience in providing firefighting manpower (like Fire man, Fire Operator, Fire Technician and DCPO (Driver cum Fire Operator)) documentary evidence is require d along with work orders issued by previous clients and completion certificate showing nature of work and their validity. 5. As per GeM terms & condition, the Buyer may increase or decrease the Contract quantity at any time du ring the Contract period and may cancel the Contract at any time during the Contract period by giving at le ast one month's notice. The Seller shall be bound by this. 6. The period of Service Contract may be extended up to one year from the initial contract period subject t o satisfactory performance and mutual consent. 7. Registered office of the bidder should be situated in Delhi and Establishment Registration Certificate (Fo rm C) issued by Labour Department, Shamnath Marg, GNCTD Delhi should be uploaded by the buyer along with the bid for verification of office address. In case the registered office is not in Delhi, the same shall be opened within 30 Days of awarding of contract & proof should be submitted within 3o days. 8. All documents required by the buyer must be uploaded in the specified column provided by GeM. Docu ments uploaded in other columns will not be considered/ Accepted. 9. The bidder has to upload an undertaking that the contract labour deployed at buyer's location will be pa id minimum wages as per the Minimum Wages Act in force along with PF, ESI etc. on time. 10. 2% of the estimated bid value shall be submitted as EMD, and 3% of the estimated bid value shall be s ubmitted as Bank Guarantee (BG), both in favour of DDO, HQ, Delhi Fire Service.

11. The Service Provider is required to have at least 30% of manpower of same qualifications as specified i n this tender on service provider's payroll for at least one year within the last 3 years. Necessary documen ts relating to such manpower should be uploaded by the bidder for buyer's verification. Such manpower wi ll be part of the total manpower to be provided by the service provider, if it gets the contract under this bi d. Complete list of manpower including details like name, designation, PF, ESIC, HMV License, name of dep artment, duration and qualification should be uploaded with the bid. 12. Past Experience of Similar Services: The Bidder must have successfully executed / completed at least o ne single order of 80% of the Estimated Bid Value of One Year or 2 orders each of 50% of the Estimated Bid Value of One Year or 3 orders each of 40% of the Estimated Bid Value of One Year for similar service(s) in l ast three years to any Central / State Govt / Organization / PSU / Public Listed Company. Copies of contrac ts / work orders and documentary evidence of successful execution / completion in support of Past Experie nce of Similar Services along with names, address and contact details of clients shall be uploaded with the bid for verification by the bidder. 13. TDS will be deducted at source for any payments made to the contractor as per the rules / instructions of the Government of India. 14. Liquidated damages will be charged as per GeM terms and conditions 15. GSTR 3B of latest month / quarter should be uploaded along with the bid. 16. The bidder should not have been debarred/blacklisted by any State Government/Central Government/ Government Institution/Department during the last 5 years. A separate declaration on notarized stamp pap er of Rs.100/-stating the details of the bid should be uploaded along with the bid and should be issued afte r the date of bid. 17. The Competent Authority reserves the right to relax any of the terms and conditions in govt. interest 18.In case of any dispute regarding levy of penalty or forfeiture of security deposit for any reason the decis ion of the Director, Delhi Fire Service, shall be final and binding upon the firm. 19. The courts of Delhi / New Delhi shall only have the jurisdiction, in case of any dispute. .
